title: Honduras
subtitle: Apparel sourcing: costs and risks
meta: Edition of 21 November 2026. Series to {series}, inflation to October and the exchange rate to 20 November from the central bank, scores of 1 November in the appendix.
excerpt: Honduras ends 2026 with the soundest accounts of the five countries covered and the weakest order book. Reserves of USD 11.6 billion, a bond of USD 816 million placed at 6.4% to retire the January 2027 maturity, a budget deficit held at 1% of GDP and the last review of the IMF programme agreed on 1 November stand against maquila exports down 9.6% in eight months, 50,000 jobs lost since 2022 and an industry that says Nicaragua is 60% cheaper.
